confirmed_findings.detail: Capture contains one User message, zero images, zero warnings. The independent private page contains a generated-image AI node still loading after an additional bounded 30-second wait. The capture does not retain that incomplete reply/status. This does not prove a fully loaded visible private image was lost.

Both images are 1024x559 in live img natural dimensions, but the saved files are 720x394. Other private-page images have enlarged stored dimensions, e.g. 09_private 2250x600 vs live 1500x400. Natural dimensions of the displayed page image are not asserted to be the uploaded original-file dimensions.

Twelve paired occurrences (six different code fragments) differ only in blank-line indentation or trailing spaces. Removing line-end spaces makes the source/capture code equal; no omitted executable statement or stdout block was found in these comparisons.

not_confirmed_as_capture_defects.detail: The twelfth raw AI DOM node remains empty in the capture snapshot and independent live review. No readable reply body was found; do not call it a confirmed lost answer.
The prose comparison candidate is a file-card UI label (uploaded file not displayed). The capture instead points to the successfully downloaded result1.xlsx, whose archive structure/CRC passed.

The only normalized prose deltas are inserted code-output labels. The image alt text is a remote URL on both the actual page and the capture; the actual image src in the export is local. It is not an unlocalized remote image target.

manual_review.limits: Only capture and live source-page comparison were performed. No summary APIs or interactive animation execution were tested. File checks establish saved-file format/integrity and route-pair hashes; they do not prove every original server file is byte-identical to an independently downloaded native original.
